meta.title: Elastic local and distortional buckling of the C89 lipped channel (finite strip method)

corner_models.sharp: centreline D - t, B - t, C - t/2, square corners
corner_models.rounded: inside radius 2.0 mm, centreline radius 2.0 + t/2

axes.x-x: major axis, parallel to the flanges, through the centroid; bending about it compresses one flange
axes.y-y: minor axis, parallel to the web; two senses: web in compression, lips in compression

meta.stress_definition: f_local and f_dist are the critical largest compressive stress at mid-thickness (centreline model, CUFSM convention) = load factor x reference stress at the extreme compressive node. f_*_outer = f_* x extreme_fibre_factor is the same buckling state read at the outer surface. resultant_* is the critical axial force (kN) or moment (kNm) of the finite strip model. Pair f_* with a centreline section modulus and f_*_outer with an outer-face section modulus; both give the same moment.
usage_notes: Multiplying f_local or f_dist by an OUTER-FACE section modulus understates the critical moment by the extreme_fibre_factor (0.9 to 1.3 % for major-axis bending, 1.4 to 2.2 % for lips in compression, 3.3 to 5.3 % for web in compression). That is on the safe side; use f_*_outer or resultant_* for the exact value.
bend_major and bend_minor_lips_comp: the distortional minimum is below the local minimum for every thickness, so a distortional check is needed for both; f_local alone is not enough.
bend_minor_web_comp has no distortional mode (f_dist is null): only local buckling of the web applies.
Rounded-corner rows are 0.6 to 7 % above the sharp-corner rows; the sharp-corner rows are the conservative choice.

method.analysis: semi-analytical finite strip method, simply supported ends, one longitudinal half-wave (signature curve)
method.minima: strict local minima of the first-mode curve, each refined by a bounded 1-D search (tolerance 1e-4 mm)

classification.basis: mode shape at the refined minimum
classification.rule: global if rigid_body_fraction >= 0.90; else distortional if junction_ratio >= 0.50 and web_junction_ratio <= 0.25; else local if both ratios <= 0.25; else mixed

method.no_distortional_minimum: f_dist = null with the reason in the row note; cFSM is not usable in pycufsm 0.2.0 here

solver.reported: pycufsm.fsm.strip where it agrees with the independent solver, else the independent solver (see each row)
solver.pycufsm_shim: pycufsm.fsm.analysis -> pycufsm.solve.analysis_p with a one-element-array-safe int(); needed because the stock call raised TypeError: only 0-dimensional arrays can be converted to Python scalars
solver.independent: class FiniteStrip in buckling_fsm.py: own strip matrices by Gauss quadrature, scipy.linalg.eigh

pycufsm_calls: pycufsm.fsm.strip(props=[[0,E,E,nu,nu,G]], nodes=[[n,x,y,1,1,1,1,stress]], elements=[[e,i,j,t,0]], lengths=lengths, springs=np.array([]), constraints=np.array([]), GBT_con={'glob':[0],'dist':[0],'local':[0],'other':[0],'o_space':1,'couple':1,'orth':2,'norm':0}, B_C='S-S', m_all=np.ones((n_lengths,1)), n_eigs=4, sect_props=sect)

pycufsm_vs_independent.compared: modes 1-4 at all 121 half-wave lengths, and mode 1 at every refined minimum
pycufsm_vs_independent.why_they_differ: round-off only. The difference grows with half-wave length because the stiffness matrix becomes ill-conditioned there (condition number about 1e11 at 3000 mm for the rounded-corner mesh); at the local and distortional minima it is far smaller.

cutwp.stock_call: ValueError: setting an array element with a sequence.

verification.note: the long half-wave check confirms A, Ix, Iy, J, Cw and x0 together (ratios within 0.5 % of 1)

meta.section_props_note: Thin-walled centreline properties. xc_from_web is measured from the WEB CENTRELINE (xc_from_web_outer_face adds t/2). x0_shear_centre_to_centroid is a distance. Rounded corners use 64 chords per corner. Centroid and shear centre lie on the x-x axis at mid-depth.
known_issues: pycufsm 0.2.0 strip() raises TypeError under numpy 2.5.5 in the compiled analysis_c; run here through an in-process shim that uses pycufsm's own pure-Python analysis_p. No installed file is changed.
pycufsm strip() crashes when fewer than n_eigs eigenvalues are below 1e6 at some length; avoided with a 100 MPa reference stress.
pycufsm node fixity flags are not applied correctly (cfsm.constr_user); not used here.
pycufsm.pre.cutwp.prop2 fails under numpy 2.5.5 and returns Cw = 0 when helped past it; Cw comes from this module.
pycufsm constrained FSM (cFSM) is unusable (wrong warping vector in y_dofs, ValueError in base_vectors); rows with no distortional minimum therefore carry f_dist = null.

rows.note: Local: web plate buckling, junctions stay put (flange/lip junction moves 0.01 of the largest displacement). Distortional: flange and lip rotate about the web junction (flange/lip junction moves 0.96, web junction 0.07 of the largest displacement); a distinct second minimum of the signature curve.

Local: web plate buckling, junctions stay put (flange/lip junction moves 0.03 of the largest displacement). Distortional: flange and lip rotate about the web junction (flange/lip junction moves 0.96, web junction 0.05 of the largest displacement); a distinct second minimum of the signature curve. The distortional minimum is LOWER than the local minimum, so distortional buckling governs elastically and a check that uses f_local alone would be unconservative.

Local: web plate buckling, junctions stay put (flange/lip junction moves 0.01 of the largest displacement). No distortional minimum: the signature curve has no second minimum and no mode with a distortional shape exists among modes 1-6 at any of the 121 half-wave lengths; both flange/lip junctions are in tension for this sense of bending. f_dist is null (constrained FSM is not usable in pycufsm 0.2.0 here, so no cFSM value is given). For the opposite sense of bending see bend_minor_lips_comp.
